changeSet.author: stockmarket
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portfolios ( id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, currency ENUM('INR','USD') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (id), INDEX idx_user (user_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

changeSet.author: stockmarket
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS holdings ( id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, portfolio_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, symbol VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, exchange ENUM('NSE','BSE','NYSE','NASDAQ') NOT NULL, quantity DECIMAL(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, average_buy_price DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, currency ENUM('INR','USD') NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_holding (portfolio_id, symbol, exchange), CONSTRAINT fk_holding_portfolio FOREIGN KEY (portfolio_id) REFERENCES portfolios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

changeSet.author: stockmarket
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions ( id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, holding_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, portfolio_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, type ENUM('BUY','SELL') NOT NULL, quantity DECIMAL(18,6) NOT NULL, price DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, notes TEXT, transacted_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_txn_holding FOREIGN KEY (holding_id) REFERENCES holdings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, INDEX idx_txn_portfolio (portfolio_id), INDEX idx_txn_at (transacted_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

changeSet.author: stockmarket
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS watchlists ( id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (id), INDEX idx_wl_user (user_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

changeSet.author: stockmarket
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS watchlist_symbols ( watchlist_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, symbol VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, exchange ENUM('NSE','BSE','NYSE','NASDAQ') NOT NULL, added_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (watchlist_id, symbol, exchange), CONSTRAINT fk_wl_sym FOREIGN KEY (watchlist_id) REFERENCES watchlists(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

changeSet.author: stockmarket
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS price_alerts ( id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, symbol VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, exchange ENUM('NSE','BSE','NYSE','NASDAQ') NOT NULL, target_price DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, direction ENUM('ABOVE','BELOW') NOT NULL, status ENUM('ACTIVE','TRIGGERED','CANCELLED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), triggered_at DATETIME(3), PRIMARY KEY (id), INDEX idx_alert_user (user_id), INDEX idx_alert_symbol_status (symbol, exchange, status) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

changeSet.author: stockmarket
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS analysis_configs ( id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, model_type ENUM('WEIGHTED_SCORE','PIOTROSKI','ALTMAN_Z','RELATIVE','CUSTOM') NOT NULL, params_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (id), INDEX idx_ac_user (user_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

changeSet.author: stockmarket
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS investment_positions ( id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, symbol VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, company_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, sector VARCHAR(128), exchange ENUM('NSE','BSE','NYSE','NASDAQ') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NSE', entry_price DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, entry_date DATE NOT NULL, quantity DECIMAL(18,6) NOT NULL, invested_amount DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 20000.00, current_stop_loss DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, high_water_mark_price DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, picked_month CHAR(7) NOT NULL COMMENT 'YYYY-MM', model_type ENUM('WEIGHTED_SCORE','PIOTROSKI','ALTMAN_Z','RELATIVE','CUSTOM', 'MAGIC_FORMULA','MULTI_FACTOR') NOT NULL, status ENUM('ACTIVE','STOPPED_OUT','TARGET_MISSED','MANUALLY_CLOSED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', closed_at DATETIME(3), close_price DECIMAL(18,4), close_pnl DECIMAL(18,4), close_reason ENUM('STOP_LOSS_HIT','TARGET_MISSED','MANUAL','SYSTEM'), created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_picked_month (picked_month), INDEX idx_status (status), INDEX idx_symbol_status (symbol, status) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
